meta.bt_team: Team rows tested on every game 2019-20 to 2026-27, each judged only on games before it: teams 8-2+ ATS in their last 10 went 421-408 (-3.3%); 15-5+ in their last 20 138-142 (-6.0%); 70%+ in today's role 426-420 (-4.0%); 2-8 or worse 398-378 (-2.4%) the next game at closing prices. Team ATS streaks are noise against the closing line.
meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2021-22 to 2026-27, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 1,246-1,168 (51.6%, -1.7% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 348-280 (55.4%, +5.5% return); the first line alone, 608-599 (50.4%, -4.1% return). Totals the same way: 1,111-1,153 (49.1%, -6.4% return). Graded at each game's closing price: mixed, near break-even and mostly inside normal luck. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: League row out of sample (2021-22 to 2026-27, each season judged on the two seasons before it): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 608-599 (50.4%, -4.1% return), lost against the closing line.
meta.bt_held: Of 39 spots the rule bet, 1 made money at closing prices in 3+ later seasons with p < .05, none of them after correcting for how many spots were tried.
